description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice Calling for Claims  to Land Parcels D/S Division, Minuwangoda - Cad. Map No. 510430
categorisation: This gazette notice exclusively concerns land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It deals with land ownership determination, cadastral mapping, and title settlement procedures, which are all core land administration functions. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette.
